recent_articles.title: Slow-moving bands of heavy rain trigger flooding and landslides in parts of China | China | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Heavy rainfall across southern and central China has led to flash flooding, landslides, and waterlogging. The **Bay of Bengal**, **South China Sea**, and **Pacific Ocean** contributed to the prolonged downpour that caused 12 deaths and forced evacuations.  Meanwhile, extreme heat warnings have been issued for northern India, with temperatures exceeding 40°C (104°F) in several regions. These conditions are expected to persist until Wednesday when thunderstorms may develop.

recent_articles.title: Focus on infrastructure, agricultural productivity, developing clusters for export: U.P. State Transformation Commission CEO - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Uttar Pradesh** is focusing on infrastructure development, agricultural productivity, and export-oriented clusters to bridge the income gap between Western and Eastern districts. **Manoj Kumar Singh**, CEO of the State Transformation Commission, highlighted the state's focus on infrastructure projects like the Ganga Expressway and Noida International Airport, aiming to develop Jewar as a cargo hub for agricultural exports. The UP-AGREES project, funded by the World Bank, aims to increase agricultural productivity in 28 low-income districts across the state.

recent_articles.title: Lakshmi could have been a child bride - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Lakshmi**, a 16-year-old girl from Uttar Pradesh, wrote a song expressing her desire to continue her education and resist early marriage. Her father initially dismissed the message but was persuaded by **anganwadi workers** and **village pradhan**.  The village now features painted messages advocating for change in response to Lakshmi's powerful lyrics.

recent_articles.title: Fake call centres duping U.S. citizens busted in Bengaluru, man from Delhi, another from U.P. arrested - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Karnataka State Cyber Command** officials raided four fake call centers in Bengaluru, uncovering a sophisticated operation that defrauded U.S. citizens by impersonating a prominent American accounting firm. The accused, Prashanth and Akash, allegedly collected millions of rupees from victims through fake tax advice, license renewal services, and counterfeit software keys.  The investigation revealed the use of shell companies to launder money and a network of over 120 employees trained to deceive victims using US accents. **Pronab Mohanty**, Director General of Cyber Command, stated that further investigations will focus on tracing the money trail and identifying bank accounts used in the fraud.

recent_articles.title: Modi, Shah are traitors who are attacking the Constitution, says Rahul at Rae Bareli meet - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, leader of the **Congress** party, criticized **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, accusing them of attacking the Constitution and supporting industrialists. He also warned of an impending economic crisis, stating that it would disproportionately affect ordinary citizens while benefiting those in power.  Gandhi unveiled a statue of Veera Pasi in Rae Bareli, highlighting his party's renewed focus on the community. He further criticized the BJP government over land acquisition policies and unemployment rates, vowing to fight for the rights of the people.

recent_articles.title: Mayawati demands extensive relief for storm victims in Uttar Pradesh - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mayawati**, president of the Bahujan Samaj Party, called on the **Uttar Pradesh** government to provide extensive support to families affected by recent storms and heavy rain that have caused at least 111 deaths. She urged the government to help people rebuild their lives after the destruction of property and loss of life.

recent_articles.title: Adhikari aide killing: CBI conducts searches at multiple locations - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The CBI** conducted searches at multiple locations in connection with the murder of West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari's aide Chandrakant Rath. The agency took over the investigation from the **West Bengal Police**, forming a seven-member special investigation team under a DIG of Special Crime from Delhi.  Rath was shot dead on May 6th, two days after the West Bengal Assembly election results were declared. Three individuals have been arrested in connection with the case, while police believe at least eight people were involved.

recent_articles.title: NIA chargesheets ‘mastermind,’ four others in Cambodia-linked ‘cyber slavery’ case - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The National Investigation Agency (NIA)** filed a charge sheet against five individuals, including absconding mastermind Anand Kumar Singh, in a case of human trafficking and “cyber slavery” in Cambodia. Three accused, Abhay Nath Dubey, Rohit Yadav, and Abhiranjan Kumar, were arrested upon arrival in Delhi from Cambodia in February. The syndicate lured Indian youth to Cambodia under false pretenses for legitimate jobs and lucrative salaries. Victims were forced to work for scam companies, subjected to mental and physical torture, including electric shocks, forceful confinement, and denial of food and water.  The NIA is working to track down the remaining members of the syndicate.

recent_articles.title: Insensitivity and lack of concern, alleges Congress on Center’s silence over U.P. storm deaths - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following a powerful storm that killed at least 111 people in Uttar Pradesh, the **Uttar Pradesh** government directed Ministers to assess the situation and provide financial assistance. The **Congress** party criticized the **Union Government's** lack of response, highlighting the condolences from Russian President Vladimir Putin as evidence of their insensitivity.  The **Uttar Pradesh** Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath announced a ₹4 lakh compensation for families who lost loved ones and directed officials to ensure relief for farmers and livestock owners.

recent_articles.title: Mayawati slams Akhilesh Yadav over Samajwadi Party spokesperson's 'anti-Brahmin remark' - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mayawati**, chief of the **Bahujan Samaj Party**, criticized **Akhilesh Yadav**, leader of the **Samajwadi Party**, for remaining silent on alleged derogatory remarks made by an SP spokesperson, Rajkumar Bhati, against Brahmins.  She argued that the silence is escalating the situation and urged **Yadav** to take action and apologize. The police in Ghaziabad have booked Bhati under Section 196(1) of the Indian Penal Code for promoting enmity between groups on grounds of religion.

recent_articles.title: Unseasonal storms leave 111 dead in Uttar Pradesh - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: At least 111 people were killed and hundreds more injured in **Uttar Pradesh** after a powerful storm brought heavy rain, strong winds, and thunderstorms.  The **U.P. Relief Commissioner’s office** reported damage to homes, trees, and electric poles across 26 districts. **Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath** directed officials to provide aid to victims and release compensation. **Samajwadi Party (SP) president Akhilesh Yadav** called for comprehensive relief efforts and urged the government to assess losses and ensure insurance payments.

recent_articles.title: Latvian PM resigns due to split in alliance over Russian drones
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Evika Silina**, the Latvian prime minister, resigned after disagreements over drone incidents from Ukraine led to the collapse of her coalition government. **Edgars Rinkevics**, the president, will hold consultations with political parties on Friday as they attempt to form a new government. The Progressive Party withdrew its support for Silina following her dismissal of defense minister **Andris Spruds**.  The opposition United List is prepared to manage the new administration and has called for a motion of no confidence against Silina.

recent_articles.title: CBI arrests key accused in cyber fraud case - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI)** arrested Lakhan Jaiprakash Jagwani, a key suspect in a transnational cyber-enabled financial fraud case involving illegal call centers targeting U.S. nationals. The syndicate operated since 2022 and impersonated officials from agencies like the DEA, FBI, and Social Security Administration to defraud victims of $8.5 million.  The agency previously seized ₹1.88 crore in cash from an "illegal" call center run by Jagwani in Noida.

recent_articles.title: India no longer a country that suffers, will strike back if Pakistan provokes us again: Rajnath Singh - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Defence Minister Rajnath Singh** warned **Pakistan** against terrorism, stating that India would respond decisively if provoked again.  He highlighted the "Operation Sindoor" campaign as a strong message to Pakistan and emphasized India's zero-tolerance policy towards terrorism, citing past military actions like the 2016 surgical strikes and 2019 Balakot airstrikes. **Singh** also condemned the Pahalgam terror attack last year, stating that India would not tolerate attacks on its citizens.

recent_articles.title: 24x7 control rooms for disaster management to be set up in Ernakulam - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **District Collector G. Priyanka** announced the activation of **Taluk Emergency Operation Centres (TEOCs)** by May 20th to prepare for the monsoon season. The district has received a ₹5 crore disaster relief fund from the **State Disaster Management Authority (SDMA)** and additional funds for desilting rivers, cleaning canals, and installing geobags along the Chellanam coast.  Local bodies have been tasked with identifying potential relief camps and furnishing equipment for emergency response.

recent_articles.title: BJP, Congress attack SP over party spokesperson’s remark on Brahmins; FIR registered - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rajkumar Bhati**, a spokesperson for the **Samajwadi Party**, faced backlash after a video surfaced showing him making derogatory remarks against the Brahmin community.  **Pankaj Chaudhary**, the state BJP president and Union Minister, condemned the comments as "indecent" and said they reflected the SP's "divide and rule" mentality. Deputy Chief Minister **Brajesh Pathak** called the remarks "disgusting" and a reflection of the SP's character.  **Ajay Rai**, the state Congress chief, demanded disciplinary action against Bhati and an apology from **Akhilesh Yadavji**, the SP chief. A case was filed against Bhati under Section 196(1) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita for allegedly promoting enmity between groups on grounds of religion.

recent_articles.title: Security stepped up for visit of Chandrababu Naidu, Rajnath Singh to Puttaparthi on May 15 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** and **Union Minister for Defence Rajnath Singh** are scheduled to visit Puttaparthi on May 15th to lay the foundation stone for a ₹1 lakh crore fifth-generation fighter aircraft manufacturing project.  The project will span 650 acres and is expected to create significant employment opportunities in the region.  **District Collector A. Shyam Prasad** oversaw security arrangements, including electricity, medical, and fire services on standby at the venue. **Superintendent of Police S. Satish Kumar** reviewed security measures for both the event and **Lokesh’s** visit to Battalapalli on May 14th.

recent_articles.title: PM austerity appeal: State leaders take steps to limit their fuel use - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, and several other state chief ministers have implemented measures to reduce fuel consumption in response to the West Asia crisis.  These include reducing convoy sizes, promoting electric vehicles, and encouraging public transport use. **Yogi Adityanath**, **Rekha Gupta**, **Mohan Yadav**, and others have also taken steps to promote sustainability within their respective states.  **Devendra Fadnavis**, **Harsh Sanghavi**, and **Acharya Devvrat** have implemented similar measures in Maharashtra, Gujarat, and Bihar respectively.

recent_articles.title: Prateek Yadav, Mulayam Singh Yadav’s younger son, passes away in Lucknow - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prateek Yadav**, the son of former Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister **Mulayam Singh Yadav** and husband of BJP leader **Aparna Bisht Yadav**, passed away on Wednesday morning at the age of 38.  He was pronounced dead after being rushed to a hospital in Lucknow where doctors could not determine the cause of death.  **Yogi Adityanath**, the current Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, expressed condolences and offered prayers for the departed soul.

recent_articles.title: A nearly 40-year-old pending case spurs Supreme Court to declare speedy trial a ‘human right’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** ruled that the right to a speedy trial is a human right, while also directing an investigation into judicial backlog and bail pleas in **Uttar Pradesh**. The case involves five police constables who brawled over their canteen cook's food choices in 1989.  This decision comes after a nearly four-decade-long legal battle.

recent_articles.title: Free vaccination for cervical cancer until May 31 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **District Collector G. Priyanka** announced the final phase of the HPV vaccination campaign against cervical cancer in the district, urging all eligible girls to receive the vaccine before May 31, 2026.  The campaign aims to vaccinate a total of 22,358 girls aged 14 and under, with only 34% currently vaccinated as of the current date. The vaccination facility will cease operation after this deadline.

recent_articles.title: AICC begins consultations with Kerala leaders in New Delhi to decide on Congress’ CM candidate - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, **Sonia Gandhi**, and **Mallikarjun Kharge** met with top Kerala leaders in New Delhi on Tuesday to discuss the selection of a Chief Minister nominee for the state. The high command is seeking bipartisan support from former KPCC presidents, Congress MLAs-elect, and other key figures to restore organizational stability after the party's recent victory.  The meeting considered several potential candidates, including **K.C. Venugopal**, **V.D. Satheesan**, **Ramesh Chennithala**, and **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra**.  **K. Muraleedharan**, a KPCC insider, stated that the high command would consider popular opinion in addition to legislative party numbers when making their decision.

recent_articles.title: Assam swearing-in LIVE: Himanta Biswa Sarma takes oath as Assam CM; Four MLAs sworn in as Ministers - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himanta Biswa Sarma** was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Assam for a second consecutive term on Tuesday, May 2, 2026. **Governor Lakshman Prasad Acharya** administered the oath of office at a ceremony held at the Veterinary Ground in Guwahati.  Joining **Sarma** were four other MLAs who took oaths as Ministers: **Rameswar Teli**, **Ajanta Neog**, **Atul Bora**, and **Charan Boro**. The event was attended by prominent figures including **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Ministers Amit Shah, Rajnath Singh, Nitin Gadkari, Sarbananda Sonowal, Pabitra Margherita**, and **BJP president Nitin Nabin**. This marks the formation of a third successive NDA government in the state.
